title: instanceof against an unrelated class is always false, so its negation is always true

ground_truth.statement: PHP gives every object exactly one parent chain, and Beta is neither a parent nor an interface of Alpha, so no instance of Alpha (or of a subclass of Alpha) is an instance of Beta. `!($value instanceof Beta)` is true for every value the parameter can hold.

mago.reason: Mago 1.57.0 analyzes a bare return as an expression. Unary Not negates the inferred instanceof result but does not invoke conditional diagnostics or assertion reconciliation. Its silence here is outside this warning's reporting scope; impossible instanceof conditions remain supported and must be tested separately.

notes: The runtime establishes the constant result independently of warning policy. PHPStan and Psalm report it. The first benchmark draft incorrectly counted Mago silence as FN. Its return, instanceof, and unary Not analysis infer the value without invoking conditional diagnostics, so this narrowly scoped warning requirement is a cited divergence instead.
